companyContext: Groupe Orientis is the French parent company that owns and operates Kusmi Tea, a premium organic tea house founded in 1867 in Saint Petersburg and headquartered in Paris with workshops in Saint-Vigor d'Ymonville (Le Havre, Normandy). The group has been B Corp certified and employs over 550 people worldwide.
brandContext: Kusmi Tea is a French Maison de thé founded in 1867 by Pavel Kousmichoff in Saint Petersburg and relocated to Paris in 1917. Made in Normandy, the brand offers organic loose-leaf teas, tea bags, herbal infusions and gift sets distributed across 35+ countries, blending Russian heritage with vibrant, contemporary, freethinking style.
campaignContext: Mise en avant des derniers produits

brandVision: To revolutionize the art of tea blends with an inclusive, joyful and resolutely modern vision — accessible, delicious and optimistic teas without elitism or pretention, where every fruit is welcome and everyone is invited. With Bubble Tea, Kusmi extends this freethinking spirit into a playful, summery in-home ritual built around organic infusions and Made-in-France fruit pearls.
brandValues: Heritage since 1867, French craftsmanship Made in Normandy, organic and B Corp certified, freedom of taste and creativity, inclusivity ("tous les fruits sont permis, tout le monde est invité"), commitment to women's causes and biodiversity (WWF, TX2 tigers), reduced plastic and 100% recyclable packaging, accessible premium quality.
